tasks.guidance: Cook until tender and allow pressure to release safely; appliance and bean age affect time.

tasks.title: Temper aromatics and finish chana sukka
tasks.evidence: Reviewed publisher method; timing/check-ins are home-cook estimates. See recipe preparation provenance.
tasks.guidance: Chop onion and garlic, temper mustard and curry leaves, then add coconut, spices, chana and tamarind; simmer until absorbed.

tasks.title: Portion, cool promptly and refrigerate
tasks.evidence: Reviewed publisher method; timing/check-ins are home-cook estimates. See recipe preparation provenance.
tasks.guidance: Transfer to shallow containers and refrigerate promptly. Do not wait for the whole pot to cool on the counter.

tasks.title: Reheat gently and keep hot
tasks.evidence: Reviewed publisher method; timing/check-ins are home-cook estimates. See recipe preparation provenance.
tasks.guidance: Stir and heat through to 165°F; add a splash of water if needed. Keep at 140°F or above until serving. Stay nearby for checks.

tasks.title: Trim sprouts and mix the glaze
tasks.evidence: Publisher method; task minutes and check-in placement are planning estimates. Make-ahead allowance is a planning estimate; follow storage notes.
tasks.guidance: Halve sprouts. Mix honey or maple syrup, balsamic vinegar, Dijon and oil; refrigerate separately from the sprouts.

tasks.title: Coat sprouts and roast, turning halfway
tasks.evidence: Publisher method; task minutes and check-in placement are planning estimates. Same-day preparation.
tasks.guidance: Preheat to 400°F. Coat sprouts, spread cut-side down and roast until browned and tender, turning halfway. Season before serving.

tasks.title: Rinse chana dal and cover with water
tasks.evidence: Publisher method; task minutes and check-in placement are planning estimates. Make-ahead allowance is a planning estimate; follow storage notes.
tasks.guidance: Rinse the dal thoroughly and cover with plenty of water.

tasks.title: Soak chana dal
tasks.evidence: Publisher method; task minutes and check-in placement are planning estimates. Make-ahead allowance is a planning estimate; follow storage notes.
tasks.guidance: Soak for 5–6 hours or overnight, then drain. Keep refrigerated during the soak; continue with cooking or grinding when it finishes.

tasks.title: Cook dal until soft; cool and blend with coconut
tasks.evidence: Publisher method; task minutes and check-in placement are planning estimates. Make-ahead allowance is a planning estimate; follow storage notes.
tasks.guidance: Pressure-cook dal until soft using your cooker instructions; let pressure release before opening. Drain and reserve the liquid. Cool enough for your blender, then blend dal and coconut separately using minimal reserved liquid.

tasks.title: Stir the doce until thick, then shape and cut
tasks.evidence: Publisher method; task minutes and check-in placement are planning estimates. Make-ahead allowance is a planning estimate; follow storage notes.
tasks.guidance: Stir dal, coconut and sugar continuously as it thickens. Add cardamom and ghee. When it forms a nonsticky dough, spread on a greased surface, mark a pattern, cool briefly and cut.

tasks.title: Let doce cool fully
tasks.evidence: Publisher method; task minutes and check-in placement are planning estimates. Make-ahead allowance is a planning estimate; follow storage notes.
tasks.guidance: Leave pieces to cool before separating and packing. For this ahead-of-time plan, refrigerate in a covered container once cool. Once cool, pack covered and refrigerate; remove portions shortly before serving.
